handback.t:
All six docs are written, committed and pushed to origin/master. The pushed state is HEAD fbf4a4b, which includes my docs; see the commit-history caveat below.

**Files** (all in C:\Users\mariu\ventures\withholding-tax-reclaim):
- business/business-plan.md
- business/market-analysis.md (competitor teardown, software-first vs manual wedge, digital-markets-first scoping with selection criteria)
- financial/model.md
- technical/overview.md
- fundraising/README.md
- hiring/README.md
- I also replaced the three placeholder folder READMEs with short pointers.
- Report is at scratchpad\build-wht-docs.md.

**WebSearch budget:** exhausted (200/200), and the docs say so. No figure was re-verified; everything is graded A/B/C from your brief and prior knowledge.
- TaxTec's $16.4B/yr and 20% are flagged B/C vendor-adjacent, and I flagged the 20% as possibly a rounded headline.
- The EU FASTER directive (adopted Dec 2024, applies from 2030) and OECD TRACE are marked B, verify.
- Rate tables and firm theses are marked C, and every firm entry says to verify on the firm's own site.

**Honesty guardrails in the docs:**
- Pre-product, no traction, and nothing here is tax advice.
- Wet-ink and local-agent markets are explicitly out of the initial addressable market. The plan starts with 2-3 digital markets and 3-5 for the first release. Which markets qualify is marked unverified.
- #1 milestone (gate G3) is real reclaims filed and money recovered on 2-3 digital markets using a design partner's real holdings, with no expansion before that.

**Financial verdict:** no scenario credibly reaches $1B. All figures are assumptions; the base-case ACV rests on the unverified 20%-unreclaimed headline.

| Scenario | Y5 run-rate | Value at 8-15x |
|---|---|---|
| Base | $11.9M | $95M-$179M |
| Bull | $43.7M | $350M-$656M |
| Bear | $2.24M | $18M-$34M |

A $1B outcome needs $67-125M ARR (about 290-890 customers), which I call an 8-12 year stretch case. The model also gives unit economics (LTV:CAC about 6x base and 1.5x bear, payback about 21-23 months), a seed target of $2.5-3.5M, and about $18M total capital to reach base Y5.

**Fundraising and hiring:**
- Fundraising covers fintech, wealthtech and tax-adjacent VCs, a Nordic and Norway section, and two outreach templates. Contacts are firm-level official channels only, with no personal details.
- Hiring covers four roles: Norway operator/CEO, cross-border-tax domain lead (highest priority), founding engineer, and a partnerships lead after G3. It also covers sourcing through recruiters and official channels, with no dossiers.

**Commit-history caveat:** another process added an MVP scaffold (src/wht_reclaim, 29 tests) to this repo while I was working. My first `git add -A` swept its in-progress files into my commit 76d70cb, and that process later committed its own work (fbf4a4b) on top. I rewrote technical/overview.md section 0 to match the real code, and I changed the "no code" statements in business-plan.md, fundraising/README.md and hiring/README.md. The code covers:
- Illustrative tables for four source markets (DE, FR, CH, ES) and four investor residences (US, GB, NO, SE).
- Out-of-scope markets IT, PT, GR.
- A deterministic stub extractor.
- The LLM provider is only a placeholder.
- A draft cover sheet that is explicitly not an authority form.
- No pass^k harness, gold set, or real filing yet.

I did not check the README's existing Repository-map line against the commit.
